{"code":"import random

def generate(rng):
    H=W=10
    g=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    # Build a sparse diamond/cross object around an 8, with 4s and one asymmetric 2.
    r=rng.randint(2,6); c=rng.randint(2,7)
    g[r][c]=8
    # choose a diagonal/orthogonal symmetric scaffold, staying in bounds
    d=rng.choice([2,1])
    # four points at diagonal offsets, plus an optional vertical/horizontal scaffold
    pts=[(r-d,c-d),(r-d,c+d),(r+d,c-d),(r+d,c+d)]
    for y,x in pts:
        if 0<=y<H and 0<=x<W: g[y][x]=4
    # add intermediate 4s in the characteristic alternating arms
    for y,x in [(r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)]:
        if 0<=y<H and 0<=x<W and rng.random()<.75: g[y][x]=4
    # one differently colored marker in a corner/endpoint position
    candidates=[p for p in pts if 0<=p[0]<H and 0<=p[1]<W]
    if candidates:
        y,x=rng.choice(candidates); g[y][x]=2
    return g"}
